text: {lead} nudges the loose stones back into the gap in the drystone wall, one at a time, and the sheep, who had been about to leave, change their minds. The shepherd leaves a flask of tea on the post.
{lead} leans into the leaning trunk and it comes down with a thump, right across the burn, which makes a bridge. On the far side, a few coins in a tin.
Something glints in a lochan. {lead} wades in, makes a few calm passes and fishes it out: a walker's purse, a bit damp.
